summary: The AccountCode system manages and processes account codes within the HSPnet framework. It includes CRUD operations and data retrieval for account codes, providing functionality for adding, updating, deleting, and retrieving account code records.
purpose: The primary purpose of the AccountCode system is to organize and manage financial or categorical codes associated with different agencies. The system ensures that codes are handled correctly according to specified business logic and validation rules.

fields.name: ID
fields.description: Unique identifier for the account code record.

fields.name: AgencyID
fields.description: Identifier for the agency associated with the account code.

fields.name: Code
fields.description: The specific code associated with the account entry.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: Detailed description of the account code.

fields.name: SortOrder
fields.description: Order in which the account codes are sorted.

workflows.name: AccountCode Record Management
steps: Execute Add or Update operations as needed.

business_rules: Account codes must have unique and specified values.
Operations are only allowed when data is valid.

calculations.name: PortfolioList
calculations.formula: Concatenate Description and Code formatted as 'Description (Code)'.

system_behavior: System validates account code details before executing database operations.
Provides error messages when validation fails.
exceptions: Operation exceptions are raised if mandatory fields are blank or invalid.
